partner.title: Partner roles
partner.infoTitle: These roles come with a built-in referral.
partner.infoBody: Partner companies post these jobs exclusively on AI Career Helper. When you apply, your profile is forwarded directly to the team along with a referral, so you skip the standard applicant pile.

apply.companyApplicationBody: Export your tailored CV below, then complete your application on {{company}}'s careers site.
apply.tip: Tip: tighten bullets to real metrics before you submit or export.
